releases.name: Packet Baron 2026-11-21
releases.body: Tower floors now show stock as stacked pallets, one pallet per million packets, with a partly filled pallet for the remainder and a pallet count. 50/50 Machine spin cost now grows gently instead of multiplying every spin. Added timed promos every 10 to 20 minutes: a 50/50 Half Off Sale that halves spin cost and Lab Overtime that runs R and D 25 percent faster, each lasting 5 minutes. Added Butter, Chipotle Honey, Watermelon Honey and Pistachio Honey packets, plus Cashews, Peanuts, Sunflower Kernels, Vitamin B, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Pink Salt, Crunchy Pepper and Parmesan. Added a search box to the Factory packet list. Each packet now has its own market. Staples like ketchup and mustard face heavy competition, so buyers drop off fast above about x2, while rare novelties hold buyers at much higher prices. Foil, holo and other special editions lose most of their collector premium when too many are sold into the market, based on units sold over the last few seconds. Stock sitting in inventory does not count, the same way an overprinted holo card is worth little, and keep their value when made in small runs. Added Hot Dog Day, Fry Day and Sushi Week holidays that lift staple prices and demand. Wholesale buyers now grow with your production lines, so a packet at normal price sells a bit faster than its lines make it, and raising the price slows sales. Fame now boosts demand on a slow curve instead of without limit, so stock no longer drains in seconds late in the game. Per packet price settings now also slow Gallery sales of that packet, so a packet priced at x100 keeps its stock.

releases.name: Conveyor Sim 2026-11-21
releases.body: Built a packet factory, then rebuilt the whole site as a visual pipeline builder. Sixteen machine types stand for parts of a website and run a live simulation using Packet Baron's sauces, wrapper styles and 50/50 packets. The agent world is gone, so the site is now a static builder. There are four examples, a Build mode to place, connect, rename and delete machines, live counts, a build saved in the browser, and share links that hold the whole plan.
